senses.gloss: m. (denom. of תּוֹר III) ox-driver, plougher with oxen:—Pl. תַּוָּרֵי, תַּוָּו׳.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 30a:1">B. Mets. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>בתורי וכ׳</he> (R. Ḥan. in Tosaf. <he>בתוו׳</he>) it refers to ploughers with oxen (left without superintendence), who may do much damage (Rashi: <he>בתוֹרֵי</he> when ploughing with oxen); <cite ref="Chullin 84b">Ḥull. 84ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 73a:8">B. Mets. 73ᵃ</cite> <he>בתורי דנפיש וכ׳</he> when the orchard (of which the fruits are sold on the tree) is ploughed by ox-drivers (or <he>בתוֹרֵי</he> with oxen), when the risk to the trees is great; (R. Ḥan. in Tosaf.: <he>בתוורי</he> it refers to cattle-dealers who, buying the calves before they are born, run great risks).
